name: Claude Code instructions note
description: Adds the 'Commands for the owner (o-cmds)' note to Claude Code's user instructions, between o-cmds markers; the rest of the file is untouched.
content:
## Commands for the owner (o-cmds)

When you ask the owner to run a command or code (a one-liner, a recipe, build and run, a check), first register it in o-cmds as a self-contained bash/zsh script: `o-cmds cmd add --name <short-slug> --desc "<what it does>"` with the script on stdin, or through the mtm MCP gateway (`run` with `cmds.cmd add`) when it is available. Put any cd and temp env inside the script. Never put secrets or work-host details in it. Tell the owner the command's name. They run it with `o-cmds cmd run NAME|N` or from the `o-cmds` TUI (newest at the bottom).
